comment-line.comment: Comment line: ** in columns 1–2; the rest of the line is arbitrary text, including further * (deepdive §6.1). One token so nothing inside can bleed.
comment-line.name: comment.line.abaqus

heading-block.comment: Job title: the data lines after *HEADING are free text (deepdive §4 catalog). Block ends at the next keyword line; comment lines inside stay comments. No sub-patterns for the body — title lines read as one free-text scope.
heading-block.name: string.unquoted.abaqus

parameter-block.comment: *PARAMETER block: the one block-aware exception (spec) — its data lines are Python: # comments, \ continuations, case-sensitive names, no D exponents (deepdive §6.3). Started by *PARAMETER but not *PARAMETER DEPENDENCE, which is a distinct keyword and resumes the normal rules.

patterns.comment: Python continuation: the \\ is the last character of the line.
patterns.name: punctuation.separator.continuation.line.python

patterns.comment: Python builtins usable in parameter expressions.
patterns.name: support.function.builtin.python

patterns.comment: Python numbers: E exponent only, D is rejected here (abaqus-inp-format §5).
patterns.name: constant.numeric.python

patterns.comment: Python arithmetic operators (** before * so it stays one token).
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arithmetic.python

patterns.comment: Python identifier: case-sensitive parameter names, anywhere in an assignment or expression.
patterns.name: variable.other.readwrite.python

keyword-line.comment: Keyword line: first non-blank character is *, the keyword may be abbreviated (unique-prefix rule — never validated), and blanks are ignored, so `* SURFACE INTER ACTION` and `*SURFACEINTERACTION` all read as keywords (format doc §1; deepdive §1.5). Empty keyword lines (`*`) are legal (deepdive §6.3). Every rule resets at the line boundary: `end` matches zero-width before the line terminator because VS Code hands each line to the grammar terminator-free.

bare-flag.comment: Bare flag (no =value): *STEP, NLGEOM; *SURFACE, MAX RATIO (deepdive §1.3). Fires only on keyword lines, after a comma, ending at the next comma or line end — so data-line word selectors (START, EDGE) stay plain field tokens.

fields.comment: Everything that can appear on a data line, a keyword-line continuation, or after a keyword name on the keyword line. Order matters: parametric and quoted first, then the file-name exemption before, the dotted-label error, then plain numbers, commas, and labels.

patterns.comment: Parametric placeholder <width> — legitimate on data lines and in keyword-parameter values (PARAM; deepdive §6.3). Only the name inside is scoped; brackets stay plain.
Quoted label: preserves blanks and case, may contain * and spaces (ELSET="One element", "ONE*ELEM"). An unterminated quote is scoped to the end of its line only.
patterns.name: string.quoted.double.abaqus

patterns.comment: File-name parameter value (INPUT=, FILE=): file names may legitimately contain dots (part2.inp), which the unquoted-label error below would otherwise flag (deepdive §1.2, §6.1).
Value-bearing parameter name before =: single- or multi-word (DEPENDENCIES, EL SET); blanks around = ignored (deepdive §1.2).
patterns.name: variable.parameter.abaqus

patterns.comment: Assignment = (blanks around it ignored, so `TYPE = ISOTROPIC` parses).
patterns.name: keyword.operator.assignment.abaqus

patterns.comment: Number: optional sign, `.5` and `1.` forms, E or D exponent (all four spellings of the deepdive §2.3 example). The guard keeps digits inside labels (Part-5-1) from tokenizing as numbers.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.abaqus

patterns.comment: Unquoted label containing a dot — the one hard label error (format doc §5; deepdive §6.1). File-name values are exempt via the rule above.
patterns.name: invalid.illegal.abaqus

patterns.comment: Comma separators, including empty fields (`,,` means default; CAE decks emit them — format doc §5).
patterns.name: punctuation.separator.abaqus

patterns.comment: Unquoted label or word selector: letters first, then digits/hyphens/underscores stay inside one token (Part-5-1, ObservationPoint, START, EDGE — deepdive §6.2's word-as-field pattern must not look like an error).
patterns.name: string.unquoted.abaqus
